candidates.c1: component amplification (indices 0/1) + NetworkX min maximal matching
candidates.c9: bipartite layers (bounded Hopcroft-Karp + Koenig per layer)
candidates.c10: labelled weighted EDS reduction + treewidth DP, bags <= 6 (bipartite)
candidates.c14: (1,2)-swap local search from the best of c1..c13
candidates.c15: reduce-and-search: (1,2)-swap ILS + exact reductions/folds, from best of c1..c14
candidates.c16: consensus forcing: vertices in all/most of c1..c15 forced, rest re-solved

caveat: Per-instance certified ratios only; a finite experiment cannot show that the UGC 2 - eps barrier for triangle-free graphs is broken (a worst-case statement).
